name: plainspeak-monitor
description: Detects explicit requests for re-explanation and guides the active agent to reframe its answer.

interface.shortDescription: Notice repeated explanations and improve them.
interface.longDescription: Detects explicit re-explanation signals, stores only derived labels, and asks the active agent to reframe the answer.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $knowledge-plane-communication and apply any PlainSpeak feedback signal.
